messages:
alex: deploy-bot kicked off blue->green shift now. change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. rolling by weight increments.

deploy-bot: Release job started for release v2025.04.2. Router config: session-affinity=sticky cookie=name=rw_session; TTL=3600s. See release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2025.04.2

maya: copying plan here — we'll do 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% with 5m probes between steps. sticky session handshake: new green instances will accept cookies with same name, set by router so sessions survive shift. confirm @kevin?

kevin: yep. prewarm green pool done earlier in the window. infra note: KV cache warmup should hit in ~2m after 10% traffic. I'm going to start first increment now: `rtrctl traffic shift --from blue --to green --weight 10 --probe http:/healthz --timeout 120s`

deploy-bot: Traffic shift step: weight=10 applied. Probe OK. backend-resp-latency p50=42ms p95=115ms

nora: watching metrics — no errors on our end. small spike in backend CPU on green, expected. continuing.

alex: reminder: pin model-version on green: model=llama2-13b-vqf:2025-04-01 to avoid auto-rollout. `infractl pin-model --service router --model llama2-13b-vqf:2025-04-01`

kevin: pinned. `infractl status --service router` shows model_pin=llama2-13b-vqf:2025-04-01 on green

maya: moving to 30% in 3..2..1 — `rtrctl traffic shift --weight 30`

deploy-bot: Traffic shift step: weight=30 applied. Probe OK. Observability: token-cost down 3%, latency steady.

nora: small increase in 5xxs from a subset of blue instances that are now seeing lower traffic — looks like a healthcheck flapping on old pool. filing quick ticket #ENG-4821 but not blocking.

kevin: note: session-stickiness uses cookie fallback; when clients have sticky cookie to blue, router rewrites cookie to green if redirect occurs. no cross-region routing expected.

alex: hold for 5m observation before 60% step. @sre-oncall can you run synthetic convo against green endpoints and check coherent state across cookies?

sre-oncall: running 50 synthetic sessions now. quick smoke: 48/50 pass, 2 show truncated conversation when KV cache miss. investigating memcache warmup.

maya: memcache warmup should be complete by 2m more. plan: proceed to 60% if no spike in errors beyond baseline.

kevin: initiating 60% -> `rtrctl traffic shift --weight 60 --probe http:/healthz --timeout 120s`

deploy-bot: Traffic shift step: weight=60 applied. Probe OK. Metrics: p95 latency +12ms, 5xx rate nominal.

nora: alert — routing anomalies detected from edge pool eu-west-1: sudden 500 errors at 1749876660, spike to 0.9% from 0.02%. Tracing shows 502 from redis connection resets on green in that region.

kevin: rolling back the last step for eu-west-1 only: `rtrctl traffic rollback --region eu-west-1 --to blue --weight 100`

deploy-bot: Region-scoped rollback started: eu-west-1 -> blue. Weight applied.

alex: good call. keep global at 60% but eu-west pinned back to blue while we debug.

sre-oncall: isolating green infra in eu-west-1 — seeing resource exhaustion on memcached nodes behind green in that region. auto-scaling didn't trigger because instance group min=3. scaling up memcached should resolve.

maya: scaling memcached group by +2 in eu-west-1: `infractl autoscale --group memcached-eu-west-1 --delta 2`

deploy-bot: autoscale accepted, new memcached instances launching. ETA ~90s.

nora: while memcached boots, some long-lived sessions still routed to green in other regions; risk of cookie mismatch is low. propose we retry region shift to green at 10% for eu-west and probe.

kevin: agree. executing `rtrctl traffic shift --region eu-west-1 --to green --weight 10 --probe http:/healthz --timeout 180s`

deploy-bot: Region shift step (eu-west-1) weight=10 applied. Probe OK.

sre-oncall: memcached boot healthy; redis connection errors cleared. synthetic sessions: 50/50 pass in eu-west now.

alex: proceed to full 100% in 10m if no regressions. keep rollback plan ready: `rtrctl traffic rollback --to blue --reason "500 spike eu-west"`

maya: putting automated rollback guard at 1% 5xx threshold for 15m window.

deploy-bot: Guard rule applied: rollback_threshold=1% 5xx over 15m. Integration note: will auto-rollback regionally if triggered.

kevin: starting final ramp to 100%: `rtrctl traffic shift --weight 100 --probe http:/healthz --timeout 300s`

deploy-bot: Traffic shift step: weight=100 applied. Probe OK. Observability summary: global p50=38ms p95=128ms 5xx=0.07% <= threshold.

nora: monitoring — no anomalies. I'll keep on-call watch for next 30m.

alex: release notes published to #releases with rollback instructions and model pin details. link: https://redwood.internal/notes/v2025.04.2

sre-oncall: thanks team. will post a short post-mortem if eu-west issue resurfaces. mark this thread resolved after 30m quiet window.

kevin: tagging: release=v2025.04.2, rolling_strategy=gradual-weight. closing runbook: /runbooks/blue-green-shift.md

deploy-bot: Release job succeeded and closed at 1749876720. Metrics persisted to internal observability.

alex: :tada: great job everyone. follow-up action: update autoscale policy for memcached in eu-west to min=5. assigning to @kevin.

kevin: noted, I'll update policy and create a small playbook entry.

maya: leaving a short note in release notes about session-cookie TTL and cookie-name compatibility.

nora: closing monitoring loop. will reopen thread if any regressions.

sre-oncall: ack. thanks.
